item.title: Call of Duty might have swapped guns and tanks for knights and swords if an Infinity Ward experiment had panned out
item.description: As much as Call of Duty is criticised for delivering the same thing every year, reports occasionally surface of attempts to take the series in bold new directions, even if none of these experiments have so far seen the light of day. And it turns out a medieval Call of Duty was also explored at one time. Read more
